newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin, Chernomyrdin to meet in Kremlin.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin, Chernomyrdin to meet in Kremlin.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin, convalescing from pneumonia at a country residence, will meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin in the Kremlin at around noon (0900 GMT) on Tuesday, the presidential press service said.
Yeltsin, 66, has visited the Kremlin a handful of times in the last 10 days, but aides say he is spending most of the time working at the secluded Gorky-9 residence.
He has clearly aged since he was taken ill with heart problems last year and with pneumonia last month. His doctors have advised him not to rush back to full-time work.
The Kremlin said on Monday Yeltsin planned few meetings this week and would work on an address due to be delivered to both houses of parliament later this month.

The press service said Yeltsin and Chernomyrdin would discuss the prime minister's visit last week to the World Economic Forum in Davos and his planned trip to the United States for a meeting with U.S. Vice President Al Gore.
